nodes.prompt:
Implement the Automated Playwright Visual Validation, Dual-Channel Inspection Engine, Deterministic Screenshot Overwrite, and Telemetry Graph Integration across skills and gvui repositories according to the 5-Phase Plan:

1. Phase 1: Headless Playwright Visual Capture Engine (gvui)
   - scripts/visual-capture.ts, playwrightVisualHarness.ts, visualMetricsCollector.ts
   - Multi-viewport capture (desktop 1280x800, tablet 768x1024, mobile 375x667), in-place overwrite, visual-report.json
2. Phase 2: Dual-Channel Validator Protocol & Automated UI Mandate (skills)
   - validator.yaml, SKILL.md, dual-channel-analyzer.ts, unit tests
3. Phase 3: Ingestion, Overwrite & Capsule Storage Pipeline (skills)
   - screenshot-ingestion.ts, screenshot-store.ts, run-ops.ts, task-review-support.ts
4. Phase 4: Graph Summary Telemetry & Visual Asset Mapping (skills)
   - asset-mapper.ts, asset-mapper-playwright.ts, asset-mapper-findings.ts, graph-generator.ts
5. Phase 5: Downstream GVUI UI Integration & Visual Lightbox Verification (gvui)
   - AssetsTab.tsx, ErrorInspector.tsx, LightboxDialog.tsx, NodeDetailDrawer.css, NodeDetailDrawer.test.tsx
